reviews.text: I would refer Goodtime pools to anyone who is looking for quality gunite pool! Mike is professional, accountable and a perfectionist on the pools he builds. He has many years of experience and it shows! We just moved to the area and he was instrumental in getting all the permitting and approvals needed for the build. He took all the stress out of the process for me and my wife! He is a veteran and recognizes those who have served and is just a good guy to work with! You won’t regret going with Goodtimes! We love our pool and look forward to the many years we will get to enjoy it!
reviews.author: Sean Vela

reviews.text: As I read the reviews of so many others , I echo all the compliments that were expressed with how Mike handled building our pool from start to finish! Not only was he an exceptional pool builder , but he was very kind , considerate and patient with us throughout the whole process. His son, Alex was a great help to us also with delivering a lot of the equipment, showing us how to use it and answering a lot of our questions . Mike also designed our pool and helped us match the waterfall stones with the stones we had on our back porch . If you are looking for an exceptional pool builder and a man that knows everything about pools and a lot of other things and is easy to work with : Mike  at GoodTimes Gunite Pools is your guy! We love our pool! A++++
reviews.author: Scott Meyers

reviews.text: Wow what can I say. Good times Gunite Pools are totally awesome. Fast and efficient and great to work with. They fixed a crack in my pool and left us with a really neat heart shape. Our granddaughters we ecstatic. Thanks so much. You are the best!!!
reviews.author: Pastor Ray Baldwin

reviews.text: My wife Gaby and I (Daniel) had a great experience with Good Times Gunite Pools. Even with some rain delays during the process, everything stayed on track and the timeline was still great. Mike was always easy to reach and answered all our questions along the way. We love how our pool turned out — it looks amazing! We’re really happy with the whole experience and would definitely recommend them to anyone thinking about building a pool.
reviews.author: Daniel Avelar

reviews.text: There aren't enough words to describe my happiness with this entire project. Mike was an absolute pleasure to work with. He was always very professional and available to answer any questions from the start to finish. Weather was on our side, and they knocked out the pool very quickly. I would recommend him to anyone who is looking to build a quality pool at an affordable price. 10/10!
reviews.author: ERIKA BEAN

reviews.text: We absolutely loved using good times gunite for our pool. Mike was fantastic to work with. He was always very professional and available to answer any questions from the start to the end. Our pool was complete in 6 weeks! I would recommend him to anyone who is looking to build a quality pool at an affordable price. 10/10!
reviews.author: Ashley Latham

reviews.text: We recently had the pleasure of working with GoodTimes Gunite pools and it was a great experience. Micheal was awesome, he was easy to work with, which made our job smooth from start to finish. Thank you Michael ! Looking forward to working together again on future projects. I would recommend this company to any to get their pools done!
reviews.author: diego hernandez

reviews.text: Mike is great to work with and is very creative. He was by far more creative than anyone else we received bids from. His crew is very talented and incredibly fast. I think that if you’re looking for something creative, unique and still affordable - Goodtimes Gunite is your best option.
reviews.author: Jeremy Harris

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The perfect 5.0 rating with 32 reviews is notable but plausible for a specialized, high-quality contractor. All reviews are detailed, specific, and emotionally genuine with no red flags for fake content. The lack of any negative reviews or complaints is unusual but could indicate excellent service and selective clientele.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating with 32 reviews (could be suspicious but not definitive)
All reviews are extremely positive with no constructive criticism
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (owner Mike, son Alex, permitting process, design help, rain delays)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowner, pastor)
Mention of specific project outcomes (heart-shaped repair, matching stones)
data.discrepancy_explanation: No contradictory ratings found. Google and BBB ratings are both excellent and consistent. Yelp data shows business listings but no rating/review count to compare.
